trigger.registry_novelty: No ranked or terminal registry family names EURI issuer redemption parity; retained all-symbol data contains active EUREURI, EURIUSDT, and EURIUSDC Spot pairs.
trigger.material_primary_research_lead: A new primary paper reports a historical access-gated EURI discount while issuer redemptions settled at par. Discovery values are not admitted into current economics.

question: Does one official issuer source prove an at-par EURI redemption identity strongly enough to test a current direction-independent Binance EUREURI discount against already-retained finite-size books without accounts, credentials, orders, transfers, or a new market request?

endpoint_classification.operation: download one public static official issuer announcement
endpoint_classification.security: public unauthenticated read-only HTTPS documentation GET
endpoint_classification.source_role: structural redemption identity only; no account access, quote, application, mint, burn, redemption, transfer, or trading semantics

required_utf8_phrases: right of redemption at any time and at par value

decision.source_gate_only: Every exact issuer, network, Binance availability, and at-par redemption phrase must exist in the single retained response.
decision.conditional_next_step: Only if the source gate passes, consume the exact hash-bound retained 60-snapshot Binance Spot population once. Reject unless EUREURI bid proceeds exceed one EUR after exact account fee or the conservative VIP0 all-taker fee, transfer redemption delay failure operating and alternative-yield costs. Never treat a legal redemption right as retail issuer-account access or instant settlement.

retry_policy: This exact official issuer GET is one-use. Preserve any HTTP error, block, format mismatch, or missing phrase and do not retry an alias. A pass proves only the structural redemption identity, never retail access, eligibility, timing, fee, capacity, after-cost profit, or deployment readiness.
